name: daily-schedule
description: Exercise the 06:00 legacy scheduler through SWT and dendrometer decisions, dispatch, same-day suppression, and scoped schedule disabling.

steps.why: Set up the legacy-to-conditional coexistence state through the database because policy H2 routes are outside this G1 backend slice. A live policy excludes the zone even when disabled.
steps.sql: INSERT INTO irrigation_policies(policy_uuid,zone_uuid,condition_json,timezone,enabled) SELECT 'synthetic-policy',zone_uuid,'{}','UTC',0 FROM irrigation_zones WHERE id=13

steps.why: The ingest workers own diagnostics and canonical readings. Seed linked and unlinked evidence, including a WATERMARK row whose device flag still looks like a valid SWT source. Supply imported durations that HTTP cannot write.
Advance this synthetic recommendation and reset only its UTC-day stamp. Recommendation writers own these fields.
steps.sql: UPDATE irrigation_schedules SET last_triggered_at=NULL WHERE irrigation_zone_id=10; UPDATE zone_daily_recommendations SET irrigation_action='decrease_10' WHERE zone_id=10; UPDATE zone_daily_recommendations SET computed_at='unknown' WHERE zone_id=8;
